Thanks again for the time today, Daniel — good conversation. Quick post-call recap and suggested next steps so we can lock calendars: 

- Goal: run a two-step pilot for MediSync (Ops walkthrough + technical deep dive) to validate integration and unit economics.
- Suggested cadence: 1) 30-min ops walkthrough (non-technical) with PM/Procurement + 2) 60-min technical deep dive with eng/infra.
- Proposed windows (US PT):
  • Mon 11/10 — ops 10:00–10:30 / tech 11:00–12:00
  • Wed 11/12 — ops 14:00–14:30 / tech 15:00–16:00

Could you confirm: which window works best, and who from your side will attend each session (names + roles)? Also flag if you prefer Zoom or Google Meet.

I attached a short agenda for each session (pilot agenda) — once you confirm attendees and time, I’ll send calendar invites (Zoom with passcode by default) and include an ICS.

Thanks — talk soon,

Ben Carter

ben.carter@redwood.inference | +1 (415) 555-0184
